chapter_title_en: The Heir of the Shao Yan Clan
chapter_seo_title: The Heir of the Shao Yan Clan Arrives—Ji Ning Faces the Grand Xia's Elite
chapter_meta_description: A warship bearing the Shao Yan clan banner descends on Serpentwing Lake. Shao Yan Nong, heir to a top-ten Grand Xia clan, has come to recruit Ji Ning—but first, a domestic storm with Nine Lotos over the cost of status.
og_title: The Heir of the Shao Yan Clan Comes Knocking
og_description: Before the politics, a clash of hearts: Ji Ning and Nine Lotos argue over servant hierarchy. Then a warship from the Grand Xia's top ten clans arrives, and the real game begins.
twitter_title: When a top-10 clan heir comes calling at your lake house
twitter_description: Shao Yan Nong's arrival at Serpentwing Lake brings the weight of three marquisates—and a domestic storm between Ji Ning and Nine Lotos over what it really means to rule.

lore_anchors.definition: The secluded lake home of Ji Ning, where his parents' ashes were scattered, now serving as a sanctuary and meeting point for major characters.
One of the top ten most powerful clans in the Grand Xia Dynasty, possessing three separate marquisate fiefs that together dwarf the Anchan Commandery.
The title held by the leader of the Shao Yan clan; a duke-level noble within the Grand Xia Dynasty's hierarchy.
A prestigious title designating the most politically powerful and well-connected scions of the Grand Xia royal capital, groomed to inherit immense authority.
A powerful old servant sworn to protect Shao Yan Nong; his presence is a testament to the clan's caution and wealth.
The full formal name of Nine Lotos, revealing her identity as the next leader of the Dong Yan clan.
